digest.component_or_area: Build system / Makefile / type checking gate
propositions: The typecheck Makefile target (line 241-242) runs mypy only over src/rebar, excluding 47 .py files in scripts/ that are used by CI gate implementations but remain type-unchecked.

CI workflow and pre-commit hook invoke scripts/*.py directly (e.g., scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py at _build-and-test.yml:124) to enforce the Verified vote, but those scripts are outside the mypy gate despite being referenced in the gating step.

Widening typecheck scope to include scripts/ surfaces 15 type errors across 6 files, all fixable without blanket ignores or per-module mypy overrides: 7 in check_raw_git_writes.py, 4 in plan_review_impact_distribution.py, and one each in 4 others.

Two of the 15 errors are latent bugs: capture_jira_fixtures calls .strip() on str | None; check_complexity_baseline passes possibly-None dict to a function requiring dict[str, int] due to incomplete narrowing guard.

Stale scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml (line 57, 63) and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml (lines 104-108) claim the type gate covers 'full library' or 'full src/rebar' only, contradicting the Makefile:1-2 declaration that CI and pre-commit are mirrored 1:1.
